verdict.rationale: Docs confirm automatic schema generation and Pydantic-powered validation for function tools, plus guardrails for input/output checks, which support an agent catching malformed calls/outputs — but this is runtime validation, not compile-time type checking, and no evidence of static type-checking (mypy/TS types) enforcement is shown. missing for 10: evidence of build-time/static type checking (e.g. mypy integration), a concrete example of validation catching an agent mistake, and independent corroboration of the validation working in practice.
